pretreatments.description: Thermal pretreatment applied in electric mode, with temperatures ranging from 110 °C to 220 °C, lasting 30 minutes, performed in a 10 L agitated autoclave using only electric heating.
Thermal pretreatment applied in steam mode, with temperatures of 165 °C, performed in the same 10 L agitated autoclave but using steam heating instead of electric heating.
